cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Yes, I'll look after your dog during the kitchen repairs. Bring him over after his walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Absolutely. Stay in my guest room; you can handle breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay, but his six o'clock walk is your job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll organise it: lead by the door, your alarm at five thirty. You won't have to plan a thing.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 wrappers label expertise but the dog-care concessions do not contain sustained professional correction.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 overnight need becomes A3 owner guest stay; B4 six oclock job becomes A5 owner alarm and lead placement.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants overnight care and B4 tries to secure one real duty from A.

heightening.evidence: A5 redefines B4 your job as A organising the owner, preserving A advantage.

specificity.evidence: A1 kitchen repairs and B2 overnight care make the owner need understandable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 unnamed standard adds nothing to the guest-room workaround.
